name: A_INGEST_ATTACHMENT
description: Fetch chat attachments (Discord/Mattermost file uploads) and fold their TEXT content into the `text` field so downstream blocks (A_EXTRACT_IOCS, triage) see a dropped .eml / .txt / .csv the same as pasted text. Reads `attachments` (array of { name, contentType, url }) and passes it through unchanged. Only text-like types are decoded (text/*, message/rfc822, application/json, and .eml/.txt/.csv/.log/.json/.md/.ics by extension); binary/image attachments are recorded as metadata, not decoded. Requires the `fetch` capability to download. No attachments → pass through unchanged. A per-attachment fetch/decode error (incl. an oversized file rejected by Content-Length) is recorded in `attachments_ingested.errors`, never crashes the flow.
